```{r}
#| label: spec
# Template of sw_unmix_dashboard_quarto(). The function prepares everything in
# spec.rds (sections, web images, figure tables); this page only lays it out.
spec <- readRDS(params$spec)
```

```{r}
#| label: verdicts
#| results: asis
# Verdict cards: label, value, note; the status sets the border colour.
if (!is.null(spec$verdicts) && nrow(spec$verdicts) > 0) {
  v <- spec$verdicts
  cards <- sprintf(
    '<div class="verdict %s"><div class="v-label">%s</div><div class="v-value">%s</div><div class="v-note">%s</div></div>',
    v$status,
    v$label,
    v$value,
    v$note
  )
  cat("```{=html}", '<div class="verdict-row">', cards, "</div>", "```", sep = "\n")
}
if (!is.null(spec$intro)) {
  cat("\n\n", spec$intro, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: body
#| results: asis
# One section per entry: the finding, then tabs for figures, the plotted data
# and notes. Built as child markdown so each reactable keeps its dependencies.
data_widget <- function(tab) {
  reactable::reactable(
    tab,
    searchable = TRUE,
    sortable = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 10,
    wrap = FALSE,
    resizable = TRUE
  )
}
render_section <- function(sec, k) {
  lines <- c(sprintf("## %s", sec$heading), "", sec$finding, "")
  figs <- sec$figures
  has_figs <- !is.null(figs) && nrow(figs) > 0
  has_notes <- length(sec$notes) > 0
  if (has_figs || has_notes) {
    lines <- c(lines, "::: {.panel-tabset}", "")
    if (has_figs) {
      lines <- c(
        lines,
        "### Figures",
        "",
        sprintf("![%s `%s`](%s){width=100%%}\n", figs$caption, figs$label, figs$web)
      )
      lines <- c(lines, "### Data", "")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(figs))) {
        lines <- c(
          lines,
          sprintf("**%s**", figs$label[i]),
          "",
          figs$data_note[i],
          "",
          if (figs$has_data[i]) {
            sprintf("```{r}\ndata_widget(spec$sections[[%d]]$tables[[%d]])\n```\n", k, i)
          }
        )
      }
    }
    if (has_notes) {
      lines <- c(lines, sprintf("### %s", spec$notes_label), "", paste0("- ", sec$notes), "")
    }
    lines <- c(lines, ":::", "")
  }
  knitr::knit_child(text = lines, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
}
out <- vapply(seq_along(spec$sections), \(k) render_section(spec$sections[[k]], k), "")
cat(out, sep = "\n\n")
```
